values.OtherEnglishNames: Nefteyugansk gas offtake, Pyt-Yakh and Karkateevy GRS supply

researcher_notes: No roster row matches (only P5414 parent trunk Komsomolsk-Surgut-Chelyabinsk and P2355 SRTO-Surgut-Omsk, neither with these endpoints). Gazprom (Gazprom transgaz Surgut) built the gas offtake from KS Yuzhno-Balykskaya to Nefteyugansk with two GRS (Karkateevy 79k m3/h, Pyt-Yakh 42k m3/h); launched 17 Sept 2026 (neftegaz.ru 936441: offtake >47 km; faktologia: total 47.3 km incl. pipelines to new GRS). Length 47.3 km sourced (>25 km). Diameter Du250 at 7.4 MPa from 2021 Glavgosexpertiza-based announcement (design length then ~44.3 km; built length differs, so diameter is design-stage, verify). Construction start Sept 2021 (sever04.ru ID=803260, verified, not cited for a value). Independent: neftegaz.ru and faktologia are separate outlets but both likely trace to a Gazprom release; treat as one original plus design-stage doc, tier high on single validated ref with length+status. PipelineType left blank (confirm vs vocab; distribution-feeder offtake). Capacity not stated in pipe terms (GRS capacities only), left blank. Owner: entity_lookup returned only 'Transgaz' at 100 for 'Gazprom Transgaz Surgut'; reconcile to existing Gazprom transgaz Surgut entity name at staging. Route not found; no GIS seen. The 84 km inter-settlement network is distribution, excluded. StartLocation/EndLocation endpoints from the 2021 title KS Yuzhno-Balykskaya - Nefteyugansk. | RULINGS 2026-09-30 (Claude, delegated by Baird): PipelineType=transmission (Gazprom transgaz offtake at 7.4 MPa from the trunk to 2 GRS, not low-pressure inter-settlement distribution); independent flag set false (neftegaz + faktologia likely trace to one Gazprom release) - tier stays high on one validated ref.
